title: ApiError
description:
An error returned by any endpoint.

A single shape for every failure, so a client has one thing to handle rather than one per endpoint.

details.description: Field-level problems, when the request failed validation.

message.description: Human-readable description, suitable for showing an operator.

ValidationError.description: A single validation problem, located by a dotted path into the model.

message.description: Human-readable description of what is wrong.

path.description: Dotted path to the offending value, for example `layers[2].slots[0].index`.
